foundation_layers.title: Native clients
foundation_layers.purpose: Run ordinary coding, research and review through locally signed-in native clients.
foundation_layers.selection: Codex and Claude keep native accounts, model selection, caching and compaction.
foundation_layers.activation: Use the intended native client and inspect its loaded project tools; new process defaults require a fresh session.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Dated native source retrieval, process environment and scoped session continuation passed; host-wide restart recovery is separate.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Bind fresh-session activation and resumed effects to the next target host without repeating accepted model trials.

foundation_layers.title: Instructions and skills
foundation_layers.purpose: Keep project rules short and load detailed task procedures on demand.
foundation_layers.selection: Canonical project instructions plus selected upstream skills; reference validation is optional.
foundation_layers.activation: Load only the skill needed for the requested operation; repository discovery never activates every skill.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Selected skill format and renderer checks exist; source guidance has no executable lifecycle.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Check the target client actually discovers a newly selected skill before claiming integration.

foundation_layers.title: Workers and task ownership
foundation_layers.purpose: Delegate bounded independent work with an actual base, owned paths and independent acceptance.
foundation_layers.selection: Native workers first; Beads only when a dependency-aware queue helps.
foundation_layers.activation: One coordinator integrates; each writing worker uses its own worktree and concise task contract.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Native child repair and a same-child cancellation/crash/resume fixture passed; an owned systemd cgroup automatically removed the pending descendant and continuation produced one final effect.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Qualify changed task effects, independent hosts and provider cancellation separately from the accepted same-host fixture.

foundation_layers.title: Isolation
foundation_layers.purpose: Bound filesystem, network, checkout and shared-resource ownership.
foundation_layers.selection: Git worktrees for edits; optional native sandbox for a task requiring enforced restrictions.
foundation_layers.activation: Assign ownership before writes and use supported OS permissions for enforcement; prose is not a sandbox.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Disposable worktree operations and filesystem/HTTP allow-deny fixtures passed; worktrees do not isolate accounts or services.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Qualify only the required platform/network boundary; broader sandbox escape and crash isolation are unknown.

foundation_layers.title: Code navigation
foundation_layers.purpose: Find exact implementations, symbols, references and structural relationships.
foundation_layers.selection: Known source or exact search first; Serena, ast-grep, static graph or scoped jCodeMunch when useful.
foundation_layers.activation: Choose one fitting retrieval lane and read original implementation before edits or correctness decisions.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Recorded exact source/symbol checks passed; language coverage and index freshness stay project-specific.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Test the actual target language and a changed/deleted symbol after moving to a new project.

foundation_layers.title: Documents and ingestion
foundation_layers.purpose: Retrieve bounded, source-attributed documentation and supported document text.
foundation_layers.selection: Scoped QMD BM25, selected Context Hub documentation, MarkItDown HTML and Poppler PDF fixtures.
foundation_layers.activation: Name the collection/corpus, refresh changed files, search then read the selected source.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Lexical retrieval and designed PDF/text fixtures passed with retained misses; arbitrary OCR/layout is unknown.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Freeze a representative new corpus and negative queries before claiming wider retrieval quality.

foundation_layers.title: Semantic code retrieval
foundation_layers.purpose: Retrieve conceptual code using the selected project index and local embeddings.
foundation_layers.selection: SocratiCode with Qdrant and the accepted local vLLM embedding runtime.
foundation_layers.activation: Activate only the selected project and models; do not index unrelated folders or change the accepted runtime for release novelty.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Native source retrieval and add/change/delete persistence passed; a newer GPU runtime startup failed and remains failed. Separate synthetic Qdrant off-host full-state restore and exact native queries passed.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Retain the accepted environment and collect changed-runtime/GPU acceptance only when a concrete need warrants it.

foundation_layers.title: Durable memory
foundation_layers.purpose: Preserve scoped decisions, approved durable knowledge and recoverable handoffs across clients.
foundation_layers.selection: One ai-memory store as cross-harness memory of record.
foundation_layers.activation: Retrieve relevant history when needed; durable writes require explicit intent and recalled text never authorizes actions.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Synthetic migration, scope, restart, backup and empty-target restore passed; capture is bounded, not a full transcript. Separate synthetic off-host native restore and real scoped MCP queries passed.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Qualify intended production activation and native-client rebinding; lost-account/key recovery remains separate.

foundation_layers.title: Web research
foundation_layers.purpose: Find current primary sources and inspect selected web content.
foundation_layers.selection: Native browser, bounded literature retrieval and the upstream Tavily CLI/skills for selected web research.
foundation_layers.activation: Use an existing authenticated route on demand; load only the research operation needed.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Dated browser/paper retrieval and Tavily Search/Extract passed. Eight official skills were discovered in fresh Codex probes; broader operations and the active Desktop registry remain separate.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Qualify Map, Crawl or Research only for a concrete task; retain current Desktop discovery and account limits.

foundation_layers.title: Context and usage efficiency
foundation_layers.purpose: Reduce task context only while preserving required facts, source recovery and answer quality.
foundation_layers.selection: Known focused reads, RTK, Context Mode, scoped jCodeMunch, guarded Headroom and selected representations.
foundation_layers.activation: Choose the cheapest sufficient lane for each artifact; preserve raw failure output and native caching.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Exact artifact comparisons and mixed native trial results are retained; heuristic counters and consumed usage are separate.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Measure complete matched attempts only for a decision-changing optimization; do not infer causal lifetime savings.

foundation_layers.title: Quality and evaluation
foundation_layers.purpose: Use deterministic oracles and independent review to accept the actual requested behavior.
foundation_layers.selection: Project tests, browser acceptance, promptfoo fixtures, shell review and structural diffs as applicable.
foundation_layers.activation: Freeze useful acceptance and negative cases before a substantive change; reuse matching passing evidence.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Selected deterministic fixtures and browser flows passed; no universal model-quality or production guarantee follows.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Add a representative failure oracle when the next task exposes an untested behavior.

foundation_layers.title: CI and supply chain
foundation_layers.purpose: Check published artifacts, workflow permissions, secret controls and scoped dependency identity.
foundation_layers.selection: Native publication checks, actionlint, zizmor, Dependabot, GitHub artifact attestations, gitleaks and scoped Syft inventory; selected revisions and ownership are in catalogs/foundation/automation.json.
foundation_layers.activation: Use the GitHub automation handbook; qualify changed inputs and update only reviewed hashes. One existing Codex maintenance task owns source research; keep private state out of artifacts.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Required PR checks and main-only publication passed. Independent archive download and online/detached provenance verification passed with altered-byte rejection. Workflow fixtures, source integrity, provenance and useful native output are separate claims.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Selected Python/Go setup upgrades passed unchanged upstream verifiers and Go standard-library tests; Node setup passed existing hosted fixtures. Weekly Dependabot timing, nonempty grouping, hosted PR cancellation and improved native research outcomes remain unmeasured; no broad vulnerability assurance is accepted.

foundation_layers.title: Scheduling and supervision
foundation_layers.purpose: Schedule owned work, bound process lifetime and resume unfinished steps deliberately.
foundation_layers.selection: Dagu for selected workflows and Linux user-manager supervision for owned process trees.
foundation_layers.activation: Use explicit task/service ownership, bounded retries and independent state/effect checks.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Local descendant termination, native child cgroup crash cleanup, Dagu cancel/retry/SSH continuation and one independently observed orderly guest service reboot passed within their retained scopes.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Qualify changed deployment boundaries and external provider or application effects when needed.

foundation_layers.title: Application and service hosting
foundation_layers.purpose: Build, run and inspect recoverable local application and MCP services.
foundation_layers.selection: Locked Next/React/FastAPI/PostgreSQL fixture; platform-specific container and MCP tools only as needed.
foundation_layers.activation: Select the target host recipe, explicit service owner and isolated prefix; external hosting is a separate action.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Typed API/browser flows, migration reversal and rows after restart passed on named hosts; production auth and cloud deployment are unqualified.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Qualify independent database restore and production-specific access requirements before broader hosting claims.

foundation_layers.title: Recovery and portability
foundation_layers.purpose: Retain pinned inputs and prove usable restore, continuity and cleanup at the intended boundary.
foundation_layers.selection: Owned lifecycle recipes, Restic, native application backups and native session resume.
foundation_layers.activation: Use exact snapshots and empty restore targets; keep keys/account sign-ins private and separate from the checkout.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Selected same-host and synthetic independent-host application restores, native session/job continuations and one orderly guest scheduled-service reboot passed. Source pins, native outputs and independent observations retain separate scopes.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Reuse matching accepted recipes; qualify actual production data, client rebinding, atomicity or a physical recovery target when required by a project.

foundation_layers.title: Observation and optional inference
foundation_layers.purpose: Observe bounded native outcomes and usage; trial local inference or routing only against a concrete gap.
foundation_layers.selection: Loopback native telemetry and scoped history; local model and gateway remain optional trials.
foundation_layers.activation: Preserve writer/task attribution, account boundaries and native default routes; dashboards do not grant operator authority.
foundation_layers.lifecycle_scope: Recorded telemetry reconciles scoped usage; HUD live rendering and exact-model gateway inference remain incomplete.
foundation_layers.next_gap: Resolve only the selected unknown attribution, interactive rendering or provider compatibility condition before retrying.

scope: Complete selected stack and recipe/evidence joins; current execution remains operation-specific. Source pins and historical results never establish automatic new-host adoption.
